meaning: Realized account balance before the current trade.
behaviour: Account state relative to starting capital.
calculation: Starting balance plus realized_pnl_before_trade.

meaning: Remaining realized-P&L distance to the platform drawdown boundary.
calculation: realized_pnl_before_trade minus the negative drawdown boundary.

meaning: Remaining realized profit required to reach the challenge target.
calculation: Profit target amount minus realized_pnl_before_trade.

meaning: Cumulative realized P&L known before the current entry.
calculation: Cumulative net profit from trades closed on or before the current opening timestamp.

meaning: Share of previously completed ideas that were profitable.
calculation: Past winning ideas divided by all past completed ideas.

meaning: Average absolute loss per lot among historical losing ideas.
calculation: Sum of absolute historical losing idea profit-per-lot divided by losing idea count.

meaning: Average profit per lot among historical winning ideas.
calculation: Sum of historical winning idea profit-per-lot divided by historical winning idea count.

meaning: Historical average win magnitude relative to average loss magnitude.
calculation: past_mean_win_profit_per_lot divided by past_mean_loss_abs_profit_per_lot.

meaning: Indicates that position size increased after the previous completed loss.
calculation: post_loss_amount_ratio > 1 for a post-loss entry.

meaning: Current trade amount relative to the amount of the previous completed losing trade.
behaviour: Measures position-size reaction after a loss.
calculation: Current amount divided by previous completed trade amount, restricted to post-loss entries.

meaning: Indicates that the most recent completed trade before the current entry was a loss.
behaviour: Identifies trades occurring immediately after a realized loss.
calculation: True when previous_completed_was_loss is True.

meaning: Minutes between the previous completed losing trade and the current trade entry.
behaviour: Measures how quickly the trader re-enters after a loss.
calculation: Current open time minus the close time of the most recent completed losing trade.

meaning: Current trade size relative to the trader's historical median size.
calculation: Current amount divided by historical median amount.

meaning: Median position size from strictly earlier trades.
calculation: Median amount across earlier trade entries within the same account and campaign.

meaning: Coefficient of variation of historical position sizes.
calculation: Historical amount standard deviation divided by historical mean amount, using strictly earlier trades.

meaning: Whether a stop-loss price is recorded.
calculation: sl_price is non-missing.

meaning: Whether a take-profit price is recorded.
calculation: tp_price is non-missing.

meaning: Planned take-profit distance relative to stop-loss distance.
calculation: Valid TP distance divided by valid SL distance.

meaning: Combined SL/TP configuration: both, SL only, TP only, or neither.
calculation: Categorical combination of has_stop_loss and has_take_profit.

meaning: Direction-adjusted stop-loss distance relative to entry price.
calculation: Positive directional SL distance divided by open price.

meaning: Direction-adjusted take-profit distance relative to entry price.
calculation: Positive directional TP distance divided by open price.

meaning: Historical trade-entry rate before the current trade.
calculation: Number of strictly earlier trade opens divided by elapsed hours since the account-campaign's first entry.

meaning: Current entry gap relative to the trader's historical median entry gap.
behaviour: Trading acceleration relative to normal pace.
calculation: Minutes since previous trade open divided by the historical median trade-open gap.

meaning: Number of trades opened during the 30 minutes immediately before the current entry.
calculation: Count of trade opens where current time - 30 minutes <= historical open time < current open time.
